chunks: Al-‘Alā’ narrated from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from Abī Ja‘far عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about a man: how does he marry his male slave to his bondwoman?

He said: “It is sufficient for him to say, ‘I have married you to so-and-so,’ and to give her whatever he wishes, either from himself or from her master. There must necessarily be some food, or a dirham, or something similar. And there is no harm in his permitting him, such that he buys from his own wealth, if he has a slave-girl or slave-girls with whom he has relations.”

key_terms.دِرْهَمٍ: a dirham given as a material payment or token
key_terms.يَطَؤُهُنَّ: he has sexual relations with them
key_terms.يُنْكِحُ: to marry off in a legal sense

ai.seo_question: How is a male slave married to a bondwoman according to Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on how a master marries his male slave to a bondwoman. It states that a simple marriage formula is sufficient, along with a material gift such as food, a dirham, or something similar, and it also permits the slave to purchase a bondwoman from his own wealth if he possesses such means.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4553 - Al-Alaa narrated from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), who said:
I asked him how a man can marry his slave to his bondwoman.

Imam (as) said: "It is sufficient for him to say, 'I have married you to so-and-so,' and to give her whatever he wishes, either from himself or from her master. There must be something given, whether it be food, a dirham, or something similar.
There is also no harm if he permits the slave to purchase a bondwoman from his own wealth, if he has any, to have relations with her."
